description: Defines a SwiftUI view component named ContextUsageBar, which visually represents the percentage of used tokens within a given context window, with customizable dimensions and color-coding based on usage.

classes.name: ContextUsageBar
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that displays a bar indicating context token usage with dynamic coloring.

methods.name: clampedFractionUsed
methods.description: Calculates the fraction of used tokens relative to the total context tokens, clamped between 0 and 1.

methods.name: percentUsed
methods.description: Returns the percentage of used tokens as an integer, or nil if total tokens are invalid.

methods.name: accessibilityValue
methods.description: Provides an accessibility label indicating the percentage of context tokens used.

methods.name: barBody
methods.description: Constructs the visual bar representing token usage, with rounded corners and color coding.
